text: This candidate received an overall score of 0.19 for the Senior Full Stack Software Developer position. The strongest evidence of their technical capability is that they "Built REST APIs," alongside listed experience with "Node.js," "React," and "Docker." Significant gaps include a lack of experience with ruby, sql, git, ci/cd, and cloud computing, as well as only 2.5 years of experience compared to the requirement. Despite the low fit and missing must-have requirements, this application has been escalated for further review.
